info.title: ToolPlane historical Agent API
info.description: Legacy public Agent execution and publication are retired. Retained transcripts and response records remain available through their original scoped read authorization; cancellation drains existing operations only. Create a newly authorized Pi Agent and a new pinned session for execution. Historical data is never repinned or resumed as Pi state.

a2aAccountToken.description: Personal account API token; server-side only. Not a Toolkit token or service key.

a2aServiceKey.description: Dedicated published-service key explicitly granted A2A scopes; server-side only.

consoleSession.name: mcp_session
consoleSession.description: Browser login cookie; sign in first. Do not paste or copy the cookie.

retired.description: Gone. Legacy execution and historical transcript mutation are retired; use a new authorized Pi Agent session rather than attempting to resume old runtime state.

unauthorized.description: The original endpoint/client read authorization is absent, expired, revoked, or outside its scope.

notFound.description: The record is not visible to this endpoint/client/subject authorization.

A2ASendParams.description: Only non-empty text/plain input is supported. Each part must contain exactly one text field (no raw, url or data); extensions and push notifications are unsupported. Generate a new messageId for new work; retry only with the identical ID and payload. returnImmediately=true returns a receipt, not completion. To continue INPUT_REQUIRED work, use a new messageId with the returned taskId and contextId. Terminal tasks cannot reopen. Root tool approvals still require an authorized operator; the credential cannot bypass them.

A2ACancelParams.description: Requests cancellation; WORKING is not proof of stopping. Poll GetTask for the final state. Completed side effects cannot be undone.

A2ATask.description: SUBMITTED and WORKING are not terminal. Only COMPLETED means success; FAILED, CANCELED and REJECTED are also terminal. INPUT_REQUIRED and AUTH_REQUIRED are interrupted states. Text output is in artifacts[].parts[].text; other output parts are untrusted data.

get.description: Enable External A2A & channel access in Agent settings after configuring its model and sandbox. Use an account-level personal Bearer token from Account settings → API tokens, belonging to a user with workspace access. Server-to-server only: every Origin header is rejected, including an empty value. Cookies, Toolkit tokens and published-service keys are not accepted. Never share an account token with third parties. Card and RPC share this URL, using GET and POST respectively.

200.description: Authenticated A2A 1.0 Agent Card. Fetching it does not start a task.

post.summary: Send, query, stream or cancel A2A tasks
post.description: A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC; choose a method from the request examples. SendMessage returns result.task; GetTask and CancelTask return the task directly in result. ListTasks returns result.tasks and nextPageToken. SendStreamingMessage and SubscribeToTask return SSE JSON-RPC envelopes containing task, statusUpdate or artifactUpdate. Streams contain task events, not individual model tokens. Disconnecting does not cancel accepted work. Check error even on HTTP 200. Notifications without id return HTTP 202 without executing a task.

200.description: JSON-RPC result or error; streaming methods use text/event-stream.

202.description: Notification accepted without executing work. Include id to invoke a method.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked Bearer credential.

403.description: Origin header present, insufficient scope, or access denied.

404.description: Agent or Endpoint unavailable to this identity.

413.description: Request exceeds the configured body limit.

429.description: Rate, concurrency or resource quota exceeded. Honor Retry-After.

put.summary: Configure inbound, outbound and collaboration authorization
put.description: Requires workspace owner or administrator. Publishes directional settings and policy as a new immutable Agent revision using revision compare-and-swap. Inbound authorization controls account-token and channel admission and delegated target access; outbound authorization and selected policy authorize delegation. Ordinary chat, control and Work entry do not require collaboration opt-in. The retired enabled alias is rejected.

200.description: Accepted directional settings and policy changes.

default.description: Authentication, authorization, configuration or validation failure.

post.summary: Try A2A with your login session
post.description: A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC; choose a method from the request examples. SendMessage returns result.task; GetTask and CancelTask return the task directly in result. ListTasks returns result.tasks and nextPageToken. SendStreamingMessage and SubscribeToTask return SSE JSON-RPC envelopes containing task, statusUpdate or artifactUpdate. Streams contain task events, not individual model tokens. Disconnecting does not cancel accepted work. Check error even on HTTP 200. Notifications without id return HTTP 202 without executing a task. Same-origin console endpoint: the browser sends your existing login cookie. Sign in first; no Bearer token is accepted. Specify a workspace slug and accessible Agent ID.

get.description: Published endpoint execution is unavailable for all currently supported Agent runtimes. Existing task history, cancellation, credentials and management remain available; new publication and task admission are rejected. Local workspace and remote Agent collaboration are independent. Requires a service key with a2a:read, a2a:send and/or a2a:cancel scopes for the requested operation; ordinary Responses keys do not grant A2A access. Keep keys server-side. Task access is scoped to the client identity that created the task. Browser Origin requests are rejected.

post.summary: Connect an MCP client to the published service
post.description: Use a standard Streamable HTTP MCP client with this URL and Authorization: Bearer <dedicated service key>. Tools: a2a_send_message, a2a_get_task, a2a_list_tasks and a2a_cancel_task. Tool arguments use the corresponding A2A parameter schemas. Send returns immediately; list returns at most 20 summaries without history/artifacts; cancel requests stopping without waiting. No personal account tokens. No browser Origin header. The transport is stateless, with no persistent session or standalone GET event stream.

200.description: MCP JSON-RPC response. Tool results contain JSON-encoded text content; check isError.
Persisted agent.response including original endpoint revision, output text, status, usage, request ID and error. No runtime is started.

post.summary: Request cancellation of an existing legacy operation without replay

200.description: Persisted response plus cancellation_requested. Cancellation does not erase history or sandbox volumes and does not imply rollback of side effects.
Original endpoint revision and bounded user/assistant messages in sequence order with a continuation cursor. No current Agent configuration or runtime recovery is substituted.
